summary: Specifies TLS ciphersuites that use pre-shared keys for authentication and integrity but do not encrypt. They are useful when confidentiality is not needed or not allowed.

eli5.summary: Sometimes you need to know a message is real and untouched but do not need it secret. These options for TLS prove who sent it and that it was not changed, but skip the scrambling.

questions: what is tls psk null encryption
subtitle: Three TLS pre-shared key ciphersuites that authenticate and protect integrity without encrypting.

tldr.problem: Every PSK ciphersuite for TLS required encryption, but some uses need only authentication and integrity, or cannot legally use encryption.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC adds three ciphersuites with NULL encryption and SHA: TLS_PSK_WITH_NULL_SHA, TLS_DHE_PSK_WITH_NULL_SHA and TLS_RSA_PSK_WITH_NULL_SHA.
tldr.outcome: They give no confidentiality, so sensitive data such as passwords should not be sent over them. The RFC was updated by RFC 8996 and RFC 10015.

today: RFC 4785 is a Proposed Standard that was updated by RFC 8996 and RFC 10015.

sections.title: Authentication Without Encryption
sections.content: The PSK ciphersuites for TLS in RFC 4279 all require encryption. But sometimes only authentication and integrity protection is wanted, and sometimes confidentiality is not permitted, for example under import restrictions in some countries. This RFC adds three ciphersuites using NULL encryption, which still authenticate client and server and protect message integrity.
sections.eli5: You can sign a letter to prove it is yours without putting it in a locked box.

sections.title: When to Use Them
sections.content: The applicability statement says these suites suit a rather limited set of applications, usually a very small number of clients and servers. Alternatives may be better: self-signed certificates with public key fingerprints, or the Secure Remote Password (SRP) ciphersuites, which protect against dictionary attacks but cost more computation than PSK.
sections.eli5: They fit small groups who already share a secret. Bigger setups should look at other options.

sections.title: The Three Ciphersuites
sections.content:
The suites match the three in RFC 4279, but with a NULL cipher and SHA as the hash. The key exchanges are PSK, DHE_PSK and RSA_PSK. They are registered in the TLS Cipher Suite registry with values {0x00, 0x2C}, {0x00, 0x2D} and {0x00, 0x2E}.

On security, shared keys must be protected and their exposure limited over time. Because there is no confidentiality, care should be taken not to send sensitive information such as passwords over these connections.
sections.eli5: There are three ways to start the conversation, and all three skip hiding the message while still checking it is real.
